Kardashev divided all potential
civilizations into three massive cosmic tiers.
A Type One civilization commands
the entire energy output of its home planet.
A Type Two civilization harnesses
the total power radiated by its parent star.
A Type Three civilization commands
the staggering energy of an entire galaxy.
It sounds like pure fantasy,
but the arithmetic behind it is simple.
Energy is the ultimate currency

water or traversing the stars.
